 Sandy Harjo Livingston Tue, November 17, 2026 at 4:17 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. HONOLULU (KHON2) -- Today, Nov. 17, will be bringing what feels like fall to the residents and visitors of Hawaii.
